title: The Fourth, 2014
logline: Ten days before the pavilion: the dock, the fireworks, Maria's chair, the invitation in Wood's coat pocket that Gully knows about. Gully asks; Wood says where it is instead of whether. That's not an answer, Gully says, and the last panel is the sky.

panels.composition: The dock at night under fireworks, MARIA in the lawn chair with the four-year-old asleep on her, GULLY and WOOD at the rail, old BARNABY under the chair.

characters.pose: in the chair, child asleep on her

image.prompt: a dock at night under fireworks with a woman in a lawn chair holding a sleeping child, two men at the rail and an old dog beneath the chair, black ink with one spot tone
a stocky man looking up at fireworks from a dock rail, black ink

panels.composition: WOOD, a hand on the pocket where the envelope is.

image.prompt: a thin man at a dock rail with one hand resting on his coat pocket, black ink

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays
